_comment: skill-forge config. Copy next to your eval set, NOT inside the skill directory.
See references/walkthrough.md for a complete worked example.
_skill: path to the skill under test, relative to this file
_cases: directory of case dirs; each holds ONE input file plus expected.json
_run: command that executes the skill's script for one case.
{python} -> interpreter, {skill} -> skill dir, {input} -> the case input file,
{output} -> scratch dir for this run. The script MUST write JSON somewhere
_result_file: where the script writes its JSON result; {output} is substituted
_rows_path: dotted path from the JSON root to the list of rows ('' = root is the list)
_key_field: field identifying a row, compared as a set (catches missing/extra rows)
_tolerance: absorbs float noise without admitting a real error; ~half the smallest meaningful unit
_editable: files the proposer may modify; keep this tight
